en.ref_text: It isn't. Here's a sequence inside the ball: f n is a tent of height one over the interval from one over n plus one to one over n, and zero everywhere else. The tents march toward zero, getting narrower, each one sitting where all the others are zero.

zh.ref_text: 配方是这样的。先取sin x。加上sin 2x除以2。再加sin 3x除以3，一直加下去，每一项是sin k x除以k。每一条波都完全光滑。

qwen3-calm-a.note: Even, lecture-like delivery: English cloned from the series' original Kokoro narration (its calmest line), Chinese from Serena's calmest Part 1 line.

en.ref_text: That a point is actually there is, again, the least-upper-bound property. If closed intervals are nested, each inside the last, then the left endpoints are bounded above by every right endpoint, so they have a supremum x, and x lies in every interval.

zh.ref_text: 配方是这样的。先取sin x。加上sin 2x除以2。再加sin 3x除以3，一直加下去，每一项是sin k x除以k。每一条波都完全光滑。
